name: XERI
description: Xeri (Ξερή, 'dry') is a popular Greek fishing card game. 2 or 4 players. 52 cards. 6 each + 4 face-up on table. Match rank to capture entire pile. Jack captures any pile. 'Xeri' = capturing lone card (10pts bonus, Jack Xeri = 20pts). Score: most cards=3pts, A/K/Q/J/10=1pt each, 10♦=1pt extra, 2♣=1pt.

content.text: Xeri (Ξερή, 'dry') is a popular Greek fishing card game. 2 or 4 players. 52 cards. 6 each + 4 face-up on table. Match rank to capture entire pile. Jack captures any pile. 'Xeri' = capturing lone card (10pts bonus, Jack Xeri = 20pts). Score: most cards=3pts, A/K/Q/J/10=1pt each, 10♦=1pt extra, 2♣=1pt.

Xeri (from Greek ξερή, meaning dry or plain) is a well-known Greek card game in which players capture the play pile by matching its top card. Play is similar to the Turkish game Pişti though scoring differs; the xeri (capturing a lone card) idea also appears in Kontsina and in Diloti. Documented from Greek contributors and widely played in Greece.
6 each + 4 face-up center. Redeal 6 when hands empty.

items.text: Four players: Played by four in partnerships, partners opposite; direction of play anticlockwise; opponent to dealer's left cuts, opponent to dealer's right leads.
Point scoring to 151: Instead of counting games won, keep cumulative points; first player or team to reach 151 or more at end of a round wins; if both reach 151 in same round, play to 251.
